question: In May 2025, who was appointed as Secretary, Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arvind Shrivastava**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arvind Shrivastava** was appointed as the **Secretary of the Department of Revenue**, Ministry of Finance in **May 2025**.
 
• This appointment is significant as the Secretary of Revenue is responsible for overseeing the functioning of revenue collection, taxation policies, and implementation of government strategies to enhance financial operations.
 
• The Department of Revenue operates under the **Ministry of Finance**, which plays a crucial role in managing the finances of the government of India, including taxation and revenue generation. *Hence, option 1 is correct.*
